correctness.rationale: Expanding |p(te^{i phi})|^2 gives a real triangular pair of equations for each complex coefficient, yielding a global polynomial inverse at all nonresonant angles and explicit counterexamples at resonance. The real Jacobian is block lower-triangular with blocks 2[[1,0],[cos(k theta),-sin(k theta)]], so its determinant is constant; at the origin it is block-diagonal, giving the exact singular values. The N+1 circular-gap argument gives a global bound and characterizes equality as primitive uniform-grid angles. The sine product follows from roots of unity. The standalone checker passed 48,078 numerical comparisons but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full natural class of normalized degree-N polynomial intensity jets is completely characterized: exactly 2N real jets suffice for global algebraic reconstruction, all resonance obstructions are explicit, and the geometrically best angle and its noise-conditioning are sharp for every degree. This directly addresses design of two-line phaseless measurements beyond qualitative irrational-line uniqueness. The fixed unweighted Taylor-jet noise metric and the constant-polynomial base point are motivated and explicitly specified; no unproved downstream global stability is claimed.
